description: Set translator context on existing keys in one batch, without touching their values: a description of which UI element the key is and where it appears, a charLimit when the UI clearly limits the length, the source location as path:line, doNotTranslate for text that stays the same in every language (product names, brands, codes), and tags. AI translation and the QA length check use this context, so give every key you create one. Only the fields you pass are sent. A key that does not exist fails with label_not_found (create it with upsert_labels first). Needs the developer role or higher. Writes to the token's base branch unless `branch` names another allowed branch.

branch.description: Branch to operate on. Defaults to the token's base (bound) branch. May name any branch in the token's allowed set: its base branch, plus branches this token created (only when the token's scope is create-own; see list_branches). Naming any other branch fails with branch_not_allowed.

labels.description: One entry per key; each needs at least one of description, charLimit, location, doNotTranslate or tags.

description.description: Which UI element this is and where it appears.

doNotTranslate.description: true: the text stays the same in every language (AI copies the source). false clears it.

location.description: Where the string is used, as "path:line".

tags.description: Tags to set (replaces the key's tags).

name: set_label_context
title: Set Label Context
